text:
sam: Quick async check — two items for today's sprint: (1) KV prefetch / eviction changes, (2) continuous-batching kernel tweak. Who's owning final validation + canary?

maria: I can own validation for KV prefetch. Ran a few workloads yesterday, saw ~6% p95 improvement for chat-heavy traces. Need an end-to-end canary though.

ben: I'll take the batching kernel tweak. PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842 — it's small but touches scheduling. CI flaky on one test.

ci-bot: CI passed for runtime PR #842 (linux-x86, smoke).

anya: @ben thanks — which test is flaky? I can reproduce locally if you point me. Also pinging @luis for infra quota for dedicated canary cluster.

ben: flaky is test_batch_schedule.test_stress — timing-sensitive. Locally I get failure with `--sequence-length 2048` under qkv-mode. I pushed a non-flaky attempt in the branch but want SRE signoff before merging.

luis: infra-bot queued: reserved 2x A100 nodes in canary pool for 3h — request 1771234. Need the namespace and kube config. @sam can you confirm namespace?

sam: namespace = runtime-canary-27. @maria please coordinate canary window with validation script. Also call out rollback signal (latency+errors). Proposed SLO: <5% p95 regression, error rate <0.1%.

maria: ack. I'll run the validation harness: `tools/qa/kv_prefetch_harness.sh --canary runtime-canary-27 --runs 20` and collect token-level p95. Sharing baseline in thread once done.

ben: I'll rebase and add an extended sleep in test to reduce flakiness. If CI green, can request merge at EOD.

anya: small code note — kernel change touches `scheduler.cc` line ~412, please add comment about async preemption to avoid surprises later.

maria: baseline numbers attached: p95 = 123ms on master for chat traces, after prefetch branch p95 = 115ms (local microbench). Will push full-run results to S3 and post link.

luis: infra-bot: kubeconfig for runtime-canary-27 posted to vault (path: secret/infra/runtime/canary-27/kubeconfig). @maria @ben confirm you have access.

ben: I have access. Running extended CI now.

ci-bot: CI run for runtime PR #842 (extended) queued.

sam: Great. Owner recap: @maria = kv prefetch validation + canary metrics, @ben = batching kernel PR + test fix, @luis = canary infra. Blockers: flaky test, need SRE watch for canary. If anyone else wants to co-own rollback hooks pls chime in.

anya: I'll be on watch for rollback tooling and can help with the tracing hooks.

maria: Posting full-run results in ~40m. If numbers look good we'll schedule canary window at 3pm PT.

ben: thx — ping me here when the canary starts and I'll tail kernel logs. :mag:

sam: Thanks team — moving to async triage. If anything urgent, @channel. :rocket:
